verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a developer platform like GitHub, but the evidence pack never documents a capability for acting on many items at once, such as bulk-editing issues, PRs or alerts. The REST/GraphQL APIs, GitHub CLI and Actions are developer building blocks a user could script bulk changes with, not a documented bulk-operation feature. Security campaigns and org-wide secret remediation are only adjacent claims with no stated bulk-action mechanics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
